title: schema.prisma Structure
description: Understand the structure of schema.prisma, including generator, datasource, and model definitions.

data.text: The `schema.prisma` file is the single source of truth for your database schema. It defines your data models, relations, and database connection in a declarative format.

items: **generator** — Configures Prisma Client generation (output, binary targets, preview features)
**model** — Defines your database tables and their fields

data.title: Minimal schema.prisma
data.content: A minimal Prisma schema file with a generator, datasource, and one model.

data.title: Note
data.text: Prisma uses the `.env` file to resolve environment variables like `DATABASE_URL`. Never hardcode database credentials in schema.prisma.
